items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses a musician named Walter Williams who was nicknamed 'Yardbird' and played like Charlie Parker, but does not describe a personal relationship with Charlie Parker himself.

ctx.x: And what did he play? A trumpet player?
Yeah, trumpet player. They were very fine musicians. Had a fellow, we called him Yardbird. We called him Yardbird. His name was Walter Williams. Yardbird Williams. And he played --
